o1.biggest_strength: Executes the lifetime value and break-even maths perfectly to firmly shut down the 20% cut proposal.
o1.biggest_mistake: Adding a 40% first-year commission tier introduces unnecessary ongoing commission inflation when the survey clearly showed payouts and tracking were the actual problems.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Skip the 40% commission bump and differentiate the partner tier through perks, credit windows, and payout thresholds instead.

o2.biggest_mistake: Very little to fault, though setting standard members to a 60-day window when 58% convert after 30 days leaves slight room for edge-case tracking loss.

reason: Both outputs are exceptional, but Output 2 wins by catching that Finance's $210,000 saving requires breaking contracts with existing referrals (saving only $38,000 on new cohorts), smartly budgeting bank transfer fees into the $40,000, and resisting an expensive 40% commission hike.
